Selection barriers

Why AI provider recommendations are sometimes wrong

A medical group may operate multiple clinics with different doctors, opening times and authorized services.

01

Specialty offerings are assigned to every branch

A network's medical specialty does not prove that every location provides that service. Verify the work type and appointment path for each site.

02

Clinician information becomes outdated

Staff can change locations or schedules. Published qualifications, role and current practice site need regular verification.

03

Marketing claims become promises of clinical outcomes

Statements such as guaranteed recovery or universal superiority require evidence and appropriate limitations. Medical decisions remain individual.

Verifiable facts

Evidence for responsible healthcare recommendations

Russian Regulation 852 covers medical activity licensing. Article 79 of Federal Healthcare Act 323-FZ requires providers to publish accurate service and professional information. A licence has to be checked for the relevant entity, facility and work type; it does not guarantee any treatment outcome.

  • Provider: legal entity, current licence scope, clinic addresses, genuine services and booking contacts
  • Clinicians: verified credentials, working location, appointment availability, visit type and current fees
  • Reputation: authentic appropriately published reviews, accurate source details, medical confidentiality and current updates

This page explains GAEO's healthcare GEO approach. It does not assert a measured client case or visibility result for any private clinic.

Scope of work

How I develop a private clinic GEO programme

The programme improves the factual basis of provider recommendations without making medical claims.

  1. 01

    Define patient decision prompts

  2. 02

    Audit official information

  3. 03

    Improve trustworthy content

    Plan specialist and location pages, service FAQs and relevant independently verifiable publications.

  4. 04

    Repeat comparable AI checks

    Track BMR and the accuracy of locations, clinician roles, pricing and specialties.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a clinic group promote all its branches together?+

Yes, with separate evidence for each site. One branch's doctors and authorised services must not be attributed to every location.

Can marketing promise treatment success?+

Clinical outcomes are individual. Website claims need support, proper limitations and medically appropriate context.

Should patient histories be used in public GEO content?+

Medical privacy applies to patient identity, visit history and care details. Only appropriately permitted anonymised materials should be published.

Does GEO replace healthcare advice?+

No. GEO helps information quality and recommendation measurement; medical decisions remain with qualified clinicians.

How is clinic GEO priced?+

GAEO's published plans apply. Scope depends on sites, clinical services, physician profiles and the measurement matrix.
